outcomes.name: orders page lists every order
outcomes.expect: Acceptance criterion 1: `/` shows the heading "Orders", a search box labelled "Search by customer", and one row per order in the id order above, each reading customer, item, then total with a dollar sign, e.g. "Alice Nguyen Standing desk $480".

outcomes.name: total is the sum of the rows shown
outcomes.expect: Acceptance criterion 2: Below the list a line reads "Total: $880", the sum of the rows shown.

outcomes.name: loading state shows a message and disables search
outcomes.expect: Acceptance criterion 3 (first sentence): While orders are loading, the page shows "Loading orders" and the search box is disabled.

outcomes.name: search opens up once orders are loaded
outcomes.expect: Acceptance criterion 3 (second sentence): Once loaded, the message disappears and the box can be typed in.

outcomes.name: typing a customer narrows the rows and the total follows
outcomes.expect: Acceptance criterion 4: Typing narrows the rows to orders whose customer name contains the text, ignoring case and surrounding spaces, and the total follows the rows: "alice" shows orders 1001 and 1003 and "Total: $515".

outcomes.name: search ignores case and surrounding spaces
outcomes.expect: Acceptance criterion 4: Typing narrows the rows to orders whose customer name contains the text, ignoring case and surrounding spaces, and the total follows the rows.

outcomes.name: search looks at customer names only
outcomes.expect: Acceptance criterion 5: Search looks at customer names only: "desk", an item word, shows no rows and "Total: $0".

outcomes.name: no match empties the list and zeroes the total
outcomes.expect: Acceptance criterion 6: When nothing matches (for example "zed"), the list is empty and the total reads "Total: $0".

outcomes.name: clearing the box restores every order
outcomes.expect: Acceptance criterion 7: Clearing the box restores all five rows and "Total: $880".
